description: This file defines a GUI component for a video equalizer in the BORIS software, including a class 'Video_equalizer' that manages brightness, saturation, contrast, gamma, and hue adjustments for multiple video players, along with functions to initialize, reset, and update parameters, and to display the equalizer widget.

classes.name: Video_equalizer
classes.description: A dialog managing video equalizer settings such as brightness, saturation, contrast, gamma, and hue for multiple video players, with methods for initialization, resetting, and handling parameter changes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the video equalizer dialog with given settings and connecting UI signals.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes UI sliders and labels for a specific player based on current equalizer settings.

methods.name: player_changed
methods.description: Handles change of selected player and re-initializes UI accordingly.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all sliders to zero for the current player.

methods.name: reset_all
methods.description: Resets all parameters to zero for all players and emits signals.

methods.name: parameter_changed
methods.description: Handles slider value changes, updates equalizer data, and emits signals.

methods.name: eventFilter
methods.description: Filters key press events to send to main window.
